checks: Selected wave28_dialogue inline tests; lib compile only
cost: read/write O(B); record O(B+N). related builds df O(W log V), scores intersections and sorts O(N log N), retains entire file. No locking, write contention/durability guarantee or overflow certificate for u64 score sums.
description: read ignores comments and rows with fewer than six tab fields; invalid time becomes zero. record updates first equal kind/clean(text), evidence/context/time and preserves source, else appends; atomic rewrite errors discarded. related scores sum 1e6/df for normalized shared words, sorts score descending, held/principle/derived/other, newest, text. carried_over keeps held nonempty differing contexts.
forward: read ignores comments and rows with fewer than six tab fields; invalid time becomes zero. record updates first equal kind/clean(text), evidence/context/time and preserves source, else appends; atomic rewrite errors discarded. related scores sum 1e6/df for normalized shared words, sorts score descending, held/principle/derived/other, newest, text. carried_over keeps held nonempty differing contexts.
inverse: TSV records admit cleaned raw strings differing in tabs/newlines; overwritten evidence/time are unrecoverable, and source stays first. Ranking admits unrelated idea insertions and query normalization collisions; total ranking is not invertible.
limitations: Isolated tempfile read/update/ranking and carried-over tests; no world seeding or production idea store access.
No executable surrogate, semantic proof, live teacher, corpus, GPU or held-out execution
state: Missing/unreadable file becomes empty. Zero overlap drops an idea; k=0 returns none. Text/evidence/source tab/newline cleaning is asymmetric: kind/context remain raw and can break TSV. seed_principles uses snapshot membership so return count need not equal new unique records.
